verdict.rationale: Guidance text was extracted from several revenue.delaware.gov pages, including the business services page, the business tax forms page and the gross receipts and withholding FAQs. The probe record states that revenue.delaware.gov "remains the open crawled surface," and the 404s on that host show it returns ordinary HTTP responses rather than a challenge page. The authenticated tax.delaware.gov portal is a filing surface, not the public reading surface, so it does not count against this story. missing for 10: an explicit keyless HTTP 200 probe of revenue.delaware.gov guidance pages recording the identified user agent, explicit confirmation of no CAPTCHA or JS-only shell, the robots.txt posture for revenue.delaware.gov, and independent corroboration.
